mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with improved corporate earnings over the next 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances following sustained increases in HOUST, or the correlation between HOUST and GDP growth is not statistically significant over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances, or the increase in INDPRO does not correlate with improved corporate earnings in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in a quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or RSAFS growth does not outpace GDPC1 growth in subsequent quarters.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE does not lead to tighter financial conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances, or the increase in PAYEMS does not correlate with improved economic activity in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which slows economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances following sustained declines in HOUST, or the correlation between HOUST and GDP growth is not statistically significant over the next quarter.
